**There is no finding to report.** The independent review ran on OpenAI (gpt-6-luna), and it approved `src/router/escalation.ts` with no substantiated bugs or design problems. It reported medium confidence.

It traced the pinned and candidate routes from `policy.ts` through `delegate.ts`. It found that pinned routes only contain the pinned provider and that `nextStep` disables fallback for them.

The reviewer couldn't run the tests. `bun test src/router/__tests__/escalation.test.ts` failed with `EROFS` because the environment's filesystem is read-only.

I agree with the verdict only partly. I read just a grep of the file: the 98-line file exists, and the pinned and max-attempts handling is at lines 36–62. I haven't verified the ladder logic or run the tests myself.
